verdict.rationale: BILL ships an explicitly versioned API: the v3 API uses `/v3/` URL paths, and a 'why upgrade to v3' page implies earlier versions and a migration path. A dated changelog also exists. However, nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-support guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version-support lifecycle and notice periods, independent corroboration of version stability.
